people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

translations.web: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
translations.bsb: Baasha king of Israel went to war against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
translations.kjv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
translations.asv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
